scoreGuide.title: How to score?
scoreGuide.lead: Score the effect, not the effort. When in doubt, go lower — strong entries should stand out.

items.1: A small favour, a minor fix, a useful detail — nice to remember.
items.2: Saved time for you or the team, removed a noticeable annoyance.
items.3: An outcome your team, users or partner teams noticed.
items.4: Impact on several teams, product metrics, money or deadlines.
items.5: The first thing you will mention at a review or in a CV.

form.title: What you did
form.titlePlaceholder: Cut frontend build time from 6 to 2 minutes
form.titleHint: One sentence: the action and the outcome
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Context: what was wrong. What you did. What changed and for whom.
form.metricsLead: Optional, but numbers convince better than words.
form.evidenceLead: Links to PRs, issues, commits and docs — where the result can be seen.

errors.quota: Plan limit reached: {limit} entries. Delete old entries or change your plan.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the entry. Try again — your input is still here.

discard.title: Leave without saving?
discard.text: Changes to this entry will be lost.

evidence.hint: A PR, issue, commit or doc — the type is detected automatically. No link — saved as a note.

delete.title: Delete this entry?
delete.text: The entry will be removed from this device (and from sync, if it is on). You can bring it back right after deleting.

missing.title: Entry not found
missing.text: It may have been deleted — here or on another device.

view.conflictText: This entry was changed differently on two devices (or deleted on one of them). You’re seeing this device’s version; the other one is saved too — choose which to keep.
